authenticity_review: The image suffers from severe giraffe anatomical degradation. The animal_pose_auditor reports HIGH artifact risk with 69.6% of keypoints below 0.5 confidence, concentrated in limbs (104 low-conf keypoints) and face (38 low-conf). Multiple instances have average confidence <0.2, indicating the model fundamentally failed to resolve giraffe structure in those regions. The fine_grained_classifier's failure to identify giraffes (top prediction: zebra at logit 3.98) corroborates that texture/pattern generation is anomalous. However, non-giraffe elements (clocks, backpacks, background) exhibit strong structural integrity: clocks pass all testable taxonomy checkpoints, backpacks show high segmentation confidence (0.9825), and depth statistics are reasonable. The spatial error (clocks above vs. right of backpacks) is a prompt adherence failure, not an authenticity defect. Authenticity penalty should reflect the giraffe-specific severity without conflating it with the otherwise competent rendering of other scene elements.
